finalText:
CHANGELOG.md now has the 4.2.0 entry, right above 4.1.0.

Out of 380 commits, only 12 things actually touch behavior. One is breaking: an expired token now returns `401` instead of `403`. One is new: failed webhooks retry with backoff. The rest are fixes, the biggest being that request bodies stopped going into the logs, and null cursors no longer crash pagination.

Everything else was dependency bumps, renames, and test cleanup, so I left it out.
